messages:
Maya R: Quick note — ran the KV-streaming + tile-merge FlashAttn variant on SM90 (CUDA 12.2) and saw a regression vs SM80. 12.1ms -> 18.7ms p99 for seq_len=2048, batch=2. Config: flash_variant=tile-merge, prefetch_window=64, kv_stream=true.

Liam T: ugh, that delta is pretty big. Did you run with the kernel-selector enabled or forced the CUDA kernel?

Maya R: Kernel selector was on. Selector picked the tiled CUDA kernel path on SM90 while SM80 was using our optimized fused CUDA kernel. I forced selector to cuda:fused and latency returned to ~12.5ms.

Priya S: interesting — could be mis-calibrated cost model for tiled vs fused on SM90. Any nvprof / CUPTI traces?

Maya R: I uploaded the perf trace to the bench dashboard and triggered bench-bot: 
```
bench run --model=gpt-small --seq 2048 --batch 2 --variant=tile-merge --kv-stream --cuda 12.2 --gpu sm_90
bench-bot: https://bench.internal/runs/1715001234/trace 
```
Trace shows a huge kernel launch stall between tile read and warp shuffle, looks like extra syncs in the tiled implementation on SM90.

Chris B: could be register pressure differences on sm90 causing spills; tiled codegen may be emitting different PTX. Can you dump cuobjdump (sm90 vs sm80) for the hot kernel?

Maya R: Dump attached in the bench link (hot_kernel_sm90.sass / hot_kernel_sm80.sass). Quick diff shows additional movs and a barrier candidate in the sm90 build.

Liam T: Also check our batching heuristic: with kv_stream enabled we lower batch_slope to favor more microbatches, and selector uses an estimated throughput model that assumes fused-attn throughput. If selector's cost model underestimates spill overhead on sm90 tiled kernels, it'll favor the wrong kernel.

Priya S: Good point. I ran a small micro-bench comparing selector estimates vs measured for both kernels: selector_estimated_throughput ratio (tiled/fused) = 1.12 on sm90 but measured ratio = 0.63. So selector is badly off.

Maya R: Created a quick repro harness: `tools/perf/attn_selector_probe.py --gpu=sm90 --variant=tile-merge --seq=2048 --batch=2 --kv_stream`. Will share.

Chris B: For immediate mitigation, add a temporary override: if gpu_family==sm90 && kv_stream then prefer fused. Put as a lightweight rule in kernel-selector config.

Priya S: I'll open an issue with the measurement artifacts and assign to kernel-team. Need to: (1) update cost-model with empirical sm90 data, (2) inspect codegen path that inserted extra moves/barriers, (3) test Triton variant parity.

Maya R: One more data point — Triton-built attention (same tile-merge algorithm) on SM90 had only a 6% regression vs SM80, so the problem looks specific to our CUDA codegen path, not the algorithm itself.

Liam T: OK. Action items: Priya to file GH issue + cost-model PR, Maya to run cuobjdump diffs and attach repro, Chris to push selector config override. I'll schedule a short sync after we have the issue. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: automated run completed: tail(latency_ms) = [11.9, 12.1, 18.7, 19.0, 18.2] (see run 1715001234).

Maya R: Filing issue now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/4567. Adding logs and cuobj dumps. Cheers.
